<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
The task is nearing completion. Alison has successfully booked the meeting for Thursday at 9:30 AM. My final responsibility is to send the confirmation email to all four partners.

The `send_confirmation_email` function requires the day, start time, and body of the email.
-   Day: Thursday
-   Start time: 09:30
-   Body: I need to compose a clear and professional email confirming the meeting details.

I will formulate a message that includes the date, time, and purpose of the meeting. It's important that the email is concise and has a professional tone suitable for the partners of a law firm.

Once I have sent the email, the task will be complete from my side. Alison has already created the booking, and I will have sent the confirmation. I'll then end my session.
</SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
